verdict.rationale: Cloudflare docs reference billing for 'hibernating WebSockets' during long-running workflows, implying built-in support for persistent WebSocket connections (likely via Durable Objects), but the evidence pack lacks dedicated documentation of the WebSocket API, hibernation API, or Durable Objects mechanics. An older community comment notes WebSockets support was still 'in beta' at one point, adding some uncertainty about maturity, though this isn't a concrete current-state failure. missing for 10: explicit docs on WebSocket/Durable Objects APIs, hands-on developer confirmation of stable persistent connections, clarity on beta status resolution.
